content.text:
Square-format epic dark-fantasy digital illustration with an elaborate, cinematic, highly detailed painted-render style. In the center foreground, a towering armored warrior stands wide-legged on fractured black volcanic rock glowing with orange lava through the cracks. He wears ornate black plate armor edged with gold, a horned full-face helmet, and a long dark-purple cape blowing to the right. He grips an enormous diagonal greatsword with both hands; the blade extends from his waist toward the upper-right corner and blazes with intense violet energy, bright magenta lightning, and a translucent purple aura.

Behind him, slightly right of center, a dark-haired male mage in black armor raises a staff topped by a luminous blue crystal. Concentric cyan magical circles, runes, and crosshair-like lines float behind the crystal. His other hand conjures a compact orange fireball.

At lower left, a pale red-haired female warrior crouches within a swirling circular surge of blue-white water and ice. She wears dark metallic armor and holds a glowing icy-blue sword angled downward across the foreground. Above and behind her, a dark-skinned male swordsman in black armor and a green hooded cloak lunges leftward, extending a long silver sword.

At lower right, a pale white-haired female warrior kneels on a jagged rock ledge. Her long hair streams leftward. She wears revealing spiked black armor, raises a large double-headed black battle axe behind her, and holds a narrow silver sword pointing down along the right edge.

Two colossal dragon heads dominate the upper sides. On the left, a blue-black, heavily scaled dragon with long swept-back horns roars inward; its eye and open throat glow electric blue, with lightning crawling over its neck and between its teeth. On the right, a black-red spiked dragon roars inward with a fiery orange eye, mouth, and throat, shedding sparks and embers. A smaller winged dragon hovers high in the center against turbulent charcoal storm clouds.

The background is split visually between icy blue on the left and volcanic orange on the right: sharp gothic mountain or castle silhouettes rise through cold mist on the left, while a burning gothic city with towers and spires stands amid flames and lava on the right. Strong blue and orange rim lighting illuminate the figures from opposite sides, while the purple sword forms the brightest diagonal focal element. Dense sparks, lightning, smoke, glowing magic, splashing water, and embers fill the scene. No visible text.
